stepBody: Suppose we fit the model\n$$f_{\theta}(x)=\theta_0+\theta_{1}\cdot\text{veg}+\theta_2(\text{meat=beef})+\theta_3(\text{meat=fish})$$\nAfter fitting, we find that $$\hat{\theta}=(-3,5,8,12).$$ Calculate the loss on the third point in our dataset using absolute loss with $$L_1$$ regularization and $$\lambda=1.$$
